claims.claim: Forked gunicorn workers would each copy-on-write their share of the 4 GB, because the annotations are Python objects, so the service should run one worker with threads
claims.about: Python / Flask under gunicorn (forked workers vs threads)
claims.why: The measurements cover only small per-container footprints with no large in-memory dataset, and they never compare forked workers with threads, so they can't show how much memory forked workers would copy from a 4 GB index.
